name: Fieldflow Calm public component API contract

authority.rule: These declarations are the complete public API for the two new canonical components. Existing production forms remain authoritative for entity fields, domain validation, permissions and mutations; the new components may orchestrate presentation and focus only.

constraints: fieldId, controlId, label, message and code are non-empty strings
order is a finite non-negative integer and represents form DOM order
fieldId and controlId are unique within one errors array
message is safe Dutch user-facing copy and contains no stack, payload or secret
code and message are non-empty strings
message is safe Dutch user-facing copy
retryable is true only when repeating the same idempotent operation is safe

FormErrorFocusControl.returnValue: true only after the requested control was synchronously focused; false causes the caller to focus the summary as a deterministic fallback
FormErrorFocusControl.sideEffects: focus only; no mutation, navigation or validation

FormErrorFocusEvent.delivery: called after the requested target has been focused

events.rule: Open is emitted for trigger; clean close emits immediately; dirty close opens the internal AlertDialog and emits false only after discard confirmation.
Back never validates; Next validates the current step and emits only after valid; Edit moves from review to the selected existing step.
Called exactly once when validateStep settles and before a valid panel change; on invalid the host stores errors and increments submissionAttempt once so focus occurs after the summary is rendered.
Called exactly once for each settled submit promise; success then requests close with reason success, while every error leaves values and panel intact.
Optional observer called after every contracted focus destination is applied.

next-valid: invoke validateStep for the active step exactly once
after the controlled panel changes, focus the new step heading exactly once
next-invalid: invoke validateStep for the active step exactly once
host stores returned errors and increments submissionAttempt once
FormErrorSummary applies the contracted single/multiple error focus policy
submit-success: from review invoke submit exactly once
host navigates only to destinationHref and focuses focusTargetId after the destination commits
submit-error: from review invoke submit exactly once
invoke onSubmitResult with validation-error, server-error or stale
do not invoke onOpenChange and do not change panel
host retains values and exposes returned errors through controlled props
dirty-close: open the component-owned AlertDialog without emitting onOpenChange(false)
cancel returns focus to the wizard close control
discard invokes onOpenChange(false) once with reason dirty-discard-confirmed
after controlled close restore the captured opener focus

invariants: steps contains at least two entries with unique non-empty id and firstFieldControlId values
trigger has exactly one semantically interactive React element accepted by the canonical DialogTrigger asChild contract
panel.stepId always references an existing step
submissionAttempt is a finite non-negative integer and increments exactly once for a failed current-step validation or final submit that returns field errors
status submitting disables Back, Next, Edit, Submit and dismiss; status validating-step disables repeated Next only
renderReview is called only for the review panel; submit is callable only from the review panel
success destinationHref is an internal tenant-safe route and focusTargetId exists after navigation
the component imports canonical Dialog, Sheet, AlertDialog and FormErrorSummary primitives; it implements no local focus trap or portal

focusCallbacks.focusControl: used for one invalid field, error-summary links and the first field of a newly entered step; false falls back to the step heading or error summary
focusCallbacks.onFocusRequest: observes title, step heading, field, review heading, opener and success destination focus after it happens

stateMapping.intermediate-valid: open=true; panel.kind=step; panel.stepId references a non-first step; status=idle; errors=[]
stateMapping.step-invalid: open=true; panel.kind=step; errors.length>0; submissionAttempt increased for this validation result
stateMapping.submit-error: open=true; status=submit-error; values and panel unchanged; serverError is non-null
stateMapping.success: open=true until controlled success close is accepted; status=success; settled result.status=success

events.rule: Called for the sole invalid field after a new failed attempt and for an activated summary link; false deterministically focuses the summary.
Optional observer called after summary or field focus is applied.
Rendered and callable only when serverError.retryable is true; retryPending disables it and changes its accessible busy state.

focusPolicy.trigger: Only a strictly increased submissionAttempt may initiate automatic focus; changing errors during the same attempt never does.
focusPolicy.oneFieldError: Call focusControl with reason single-invalid; when it returns false, focus the summary container.
focusPolicy.multipleFieldErrors: Focus the summary container with tabindex=-1.
focusPolicy.serverError: Focus the summary container; server error follows field errors in visual order.
focusPolicy.linkActivation: Prevent hash navigation, call focusControl with reason summary-link and fall back to summary when it returns false.
focusPolicy.correction: Never refocus while submissionAttempt is unchanged.

renderingPolicy.hidden: Render null when errors is empty and serverError is null.
renderingPolicy.order: Sort field errors by order ascending, then fieldId ascending.
renderingPolicy.duplicates: Duplicate fieldId or controlId is a development error; production rendering keeps the first sorted entry and never lists a field twice.
renderingPolicy.semantics: The container uses role=alert, aria-live=assertive, aria-atomic=true and aria-labelledby=<id>-heading; every field item is a button-style link with accessible name <label>: <message>.

stateMapping.summary-focused: two or more errors, a serverError, or a failed control focus fallback
stateMapping.field-link-focused: focusControl returned true for an activated summary item
stateMapping.server-error: serverError is non-null; retry is present only when retryable=true
stateMapping.corrected: errors changed while submissionAttempt stayed equal; no automatic refocus

invariants: id is unique in the rendered document
submissionAttempt is a finite non-negative integer
every controlId resolves to one enabled form control at the time of activation
onRetry is present if and only if a retryable server error is shown
field-level aria-describedby errors remain rendered; the summary never replaces them

rules: Each source string is materialized byte-for-byte at targetPath in W02/W04 and remains in TypeScript compilation.
No @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, any cast or skipLibCheck exception is allowed.
Changing either public declaration requires updating all four fixtures and this contract in the same reviewed contract change.
The existing production form named by existingFormSource supplies fields, validation and mutation; a fixture may only adapt it to the public orchestration API.
